points.label: North Branch Tracadie fork
points.identity_evidence: Historical northwest stem rounds the mill bend and joins eastern and southern arms before the southern arm crosses the road. Modern 264843 connects the former target (a lake outlet, WALK20 121129/121130) to the actual downstream three-way junction of southern 264842 and eastern 212484. The outlet has two shore edges, not two tributaries. Native junction pixel remains unchanged.
